name: digital-signage-management
description: Production-ready digital signage management platform for a coaching institute

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,web,player -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:player"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @dsm/backend && npm run build -w @dsm/web && npm run build -w @dsm/player
